channel.title: AmplitudeLand Scientific Weblog
channel.description: Peer-grade scientific monographs with native LaTeX equations and GitHub CMS versioning.

item.title: Topological Protection and Threshold Scaling in Planar Surface Codes
item.description: We derive the sub-threshold logical error suppression law for planar stabilizer lattices under asymmetric Pauli-Z biased noise and validate decoder runtime scaling up to code distance d = 21.

item.title: Vorticity Stretching and Energy Cascades in Incompressible Turbulence
item.description: An analytical decomposition of the three-dimensional enstrophy budget examining alignment between the vorticity vector and the intermediate strain-rate eigenvector.

item.title: Kan Extensions as Universal Approximations in Monoidal Categories
item.description: A structural exposition showing how left and right Kan extensions unify sheafification, Fourier-like integral transforms, and enriched profunctor composition.

item.title: Finite-Time Corrections to Landauer Erasure in Overdamped Potentials
item.description: Using optimal transport on Wasserstein-2 manifolds, we compute the exact minimum dissipated heat required to reset a symmetric double-well bit in finite duration tau.

item.title: Linear Stability Criteria for Two-Component Turing Morphogenesis
item.description: Necessary and sufficient Jacobian conditions for diffusion-driven spatial symmetry breaking in coupled activator-inhibitor biochemical networks.
